debrief db-021
row 1: the a-c-t-o-r b-u-i-l-t a r-o-m-a-n-c-e p-e-r-s-o-n-a u-s-i-n-g s-t-o-l-e-n i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s a-n-d a f-a-k-e b-i-o a-s-s-e-t, e-x-t-r-a-c-t-e-d e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s v-i-a f-a-k-e h-o-s-p-i-t-a-l i-n-v-o-i-c-e-s, a-n-d k-e-p-t v-i-c-t-i-m-s i-s-o-l-a-t-e-d f-r-o-m c-o-m-p-a-r-i-n-g n-o-t-e-s | w-h-o-l-e-s-a-l-e p-a-y-m-e-n-t g-a-t-e-w-a-y w-i-t-h e-s-c-r-o-w a-c-c-e-p-t-a-n-c-e, f-a-k-e m-e-d-i-c-a-l i-n-v-o-i-c-e p-d-f t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s, a-n-d a s-h-a-r-e-d c-l-o-u-d c-o-n-t-a-c-t l-i-s-t w-i-t-h a-u-t-o d-e-l-e-t-e r-u-l-e | e-v-a-d-e-d f-r-a-u-d m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g b-y f-r-a-c-t-i-o-n-a-l i-z-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-s u-n-d-e-r t-h-e a-l-e-r-t t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d a-n-d u-s-i-n-g c-o-n-s-u-m-e-r t-o c-o-n-s-u-m-e-r g-a-t-e-w-a-y-s t-h-a-t l-a-c-k a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n | a-n-a-l-y-z-e p-a-y-m-e-n-t v-e-l-o-c-i-t-y m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a a-g-a-i-n-s-t v-i-c-t-i-m d-e-m-o-g-r-a-p-h-i-c p-r-o-f-i-l-e-s t-o d-e-t-e-c-t u-n-u-s-u-a-l u-r-g-e-n-c-y a-n-d a-m-o-u-n-t p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s
row 2: the a-c-t-o-r m-i-m-i-c-k-e-d a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e c-h-r-i-s-i-s r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e t-e-a-m p-e-r-s-o-n-a a-n-d u-s-e-d s-c-a-r-i-c-i-t-y f-r-a-m-i-n-g t-o d-i-s-c-o-u-r-a-g-e v-i-c-t-i-m-s f-r-o-m v-e-r-i-f-y-i-n-g w-i-t-h i-n-s-t-i-t-u-t-i-o-n-s | s-p-o-o-f-e-d s-e-n-d-e-r a-d-d-r-e-s-s a-n-d d-o-m-a-i-n w-i-t-h s-p-f r-e-c-o-r-d-s, s-t-a-g-g-e-r-e-d m-e-s-s-a-g-e t-i-m-i-n-g t-o s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e h-u-m-a-n r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s, a-n-d p-r-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-d t-e-r-m-i-n-o-l-o-g-y t-o a-p-p-e-a-r a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-a-t-i-v-e | e-v-a-d-e-d d-o-m-a-i-n r-e-p-u-t-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k-s b-y u-s-i-n-g l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e l-o-o-k-a-l-i-k-e d-o-m-a-i-n-s t-h-a-t p-a-s-s b-a-s-i-c w-h-i-t-e-l-i-s-t f-i-l-t-e-r-s a-n-d d-i-s-c-o-u-r-a-g-e-d i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-h-r-o-u-g-h a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-y a-p-p-e-a-l-s | r-e-q-u-i-r-e a-n-d l-o-g a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n c-o-d-e-s f-o-r a-l-l e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t r-e-q-u-e-s-t-s, a-n-d c-r-o-s-s-c-h-e-c-k c-o-n-t-a-c-t a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l r-o-l-l c-a-l-l d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y-s
row 3: the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e-s b-y o-f-f-e-r-i-n-g l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e-s-o-u-n-d-i-n-g p-a-r-t-t-i-m-e w-o-r-k o-p-p-o-r-t-u-n-i-t-i-e-s w-i-t-h c-l-a-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s | f-a-k-e j-o-b l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s o-n l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m-s, p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l e-n-v-e-l-o-p-e-s d-r-o-p-p-e-d a-t m-u-l-e r-e-s-i-d-e-n-c-e-s, a-n-d u-s-e o-f p-r-e-p-a-i-d s-m-a-r-t-p-h-o-n-e-s a-n-d t-e-m-p-o-r-a-r-y e-m-a-i-l a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s f-o-r c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n | e-v-a-d-e-d k-y-c r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t-s b-y f-r-a-c-t-i-o-n-a-l i-z-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-s u-n-d-e-r b-a-n-k r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d-s a-n-d u-s-i-n-g c-o-n-s-u-m-e-r b-a-n-k a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s t-h-a-t a-p-p-e-a-r u-n-u-s-u-a-l l-o-w r-i-s-k b-a-s-e-d o-n a-c-c-o-u-n-t h-i-s-t-o-r-y | i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t r-e-a-l t-i-m-e a-g-g-r-e-g-a-t-e-d t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r t-r-a-c-i-n-g a-c-r-o-s-s l-i-n-k-e-d a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s a-n-d a-l-e-r-t o-n r-a-p-i-d l-a-y-e-r e-x-p-a-n-s-i-o-n p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s f-r-o-m s-i-n-g-l-e o-r i-g-i-n a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s
row 4: the a-c-t-o-r k-e-p-t v-i-c-t-i-m-s i-s-o-l-a-t-e-d b-y p-e-r-s-u-a-d-i-n-g t-h-e-m t-o d-e-l-e-t-e m-e-s-s-a-g-e h-i-s-t-o-r-y, b-l-o-c-k o-t-h-e-r c-o-n-t-a-c-t-s, a-n-d a-v-o-i-d d-i-s-c-u-s-s-i-o-n w-i-t-h a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-i-e-s | g-u-i-l-t i-n-d-u-c-t-i-o-n s-c-r-i-p-t-s a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-n-g b-l-a-m-e f-o-r l-e-a-k-i-n-g p-r-i-v-a-t-e i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n, t-h-r-e-a-t-s o f l-a-g-a-l a-c-t-i-o-n i-f v-i-c-t-i-m-s r-e-p-o-r-t, a-n-d i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n-s t-o u-s-e d-i-s-p-o-s-a-b-l-e m-e-t-h-o-d-s o f c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n l-i-k-e b-u-r-n-e-r a-p-p-s | e-v-a-d-e-d v-i-c-t-i-m r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g b-y c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a c-l-i-m-a-t-e o f s-h-a-m-e a-n-d f-e-a-r, a-n-d p-r-e-v-e-n-t-i-n-g c-r-o-s-s v-i-c-t-i-m c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-h-r-o-u-g-h i-s-o-l-a-t-i-o-n t-a-c-t-i-c-s a-n-d s-t-o-r-m-i-n-g c-o-m-m-u-n-i-t-y f-o-r-u-m-s w-i-t-h f-a-k-e p-o-s-i-t-i-v-e r-e-v-i-e-w-s | m-o-n-i-t-o-r f-o-r s-i-m-i-l-a-r v-i-c-t-i-m t-e-s-t-i-m-o-n-y p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s a-c-r-o-s-s r-e-p-o-r-t-s, a-n-d i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y w-a-r-n-i-n-g-s t-h-a-t e-n-c-o-u-r-a-g-e v-i-c-t-i-m-s t-o s-h-a-r-e i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n w-i-t-h l-a-w e-n-f-o-r-c-e-m-e-n-t
row 5: the a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d b-e-l-i-e-v-a-b-l-e e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y s-c-e-n-a-r-i-o-s u-s-i-n-g f-a-k-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s, s-t-a-g-e-d v-i-d-e-o c-a-l-l-s, a-n-d t-i-m-e-d m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s t-o s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e r-e-a-l t-i-m-e c-r-i-s-e-s | d-e-e-p-f-a-k-e v-i-d-e-o g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-o-n u-s-i-n-g s-t-o-l-e-n p-h-o-t-o-g-r-a-p-h-s, f-a-k-e b-a-n-k s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t-s g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d w-i-t-h d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t c-r-e-a-t-i-o-n s-o-f-t-w-a-r-e, a-n-d c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d m-e-s-s-a-g-e t-i-m-i-n-g a-c-r-o-s-s m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e d-e-v-i-c-e-s | e-v-a-d-e-d i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n b-y u-s-i-n-g h-i-g-h q-u-a-l-i-t-y f-a-k-e s o c i-a l m-e-d-i-a p-r-o-f-i-l-e-s w-i-t h i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-c-y, a-n-d e-x-p-l-o-i-t-i-n-g h-u-m-a-n r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e t-o e-m-o-t-i-o-n-a-l u-r-g-e-n-c-y o-v-e-r r-a-t-i-o-n-a-l d-o-u-b-t | r-e-q-u-i-r-e m-u-l-t-i f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n f-o-r a-l l e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y r-e-q-u-e-s-t-s, a-n-d i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y c-o-o-l-i-n-g p-e-r-i-o-d b-e-f-o-r-e p-r-o-c-e-s-s-i-n-g u-n-u-s-u-a-l p-a-y-m-e-n-t d-e-m-a-n-d-s
